method: Point in time, quarterly from 2019-Q3. Each row's book on each date: the fund's SEC N-PORT filing for that quarter (every line's weight and its own price on the period date; SPY's book is IVV's, the same index, because SPY files no N-PORT), or for a basket today's members at equal weight priced from prices.db on each quarter end (membership hindsight). Each company's figures as known on the date: fundamentals.py's parser run on the SEC facts filed on or before it, so later restatements and later filings cannot reach it. Market value = the line's price on the date x the share count known then. Then the same look-through composite and 70 pct coverage rule as rotation_fundamentals.json. 'public' is the N-PORT's filing date, when that quarter's book became public. Companies that have lost their ticker since are uncovered, so early quarters can cover less; each quarter prints its coverage.
